hints.title: Circular Path Direction Consistency
hints.text: A cyclic trajectory in a circular array exists if traversing next indices with consistent signs repeats a sequence of length greater than one.

hints.title: Two-Pointer Fast and Slow Cycle Detection
hints.text: Use slow and fast pointers. Step next indices modulo length. If direction flips or if next pointer points to itself, the path cannot form a valid cycle.

hints.title: In-Place Traversed Index Marking
hints.text: When a search terminates without a valid cycle, traverse the visited path and mark nodes with 0 to prevent redundant visits in future iterations.

complexity.notes: Floyd cycle finding with in-place zero marking.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Maintaining visited sets per node uses O(N) extra space and incurs set lookup overhead.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Zeroing failed paths ensures each element is examined at most twice in O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Apply cycle detection with direction verification and in-place marking.
